subject: Cleanup schedule and form question
text: Here is a cleanup weekend update. The schedule changed because the shelter needs the van by noon, so we meet at 8 instead of 9. Gloves are enough, but bin liners are still coming. There is one confusing part. The site coordinator asked us to make the forms visible, but I am not sure whether that means posting them on the shed, handing them to volunteers, or photographing them for the newsletter. If you arrive before volunteers, keep the instructions with you and ask me at the east gate before I start the short morning briefing.
